items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And, Scott, I know you have a lot of things to do.

ctx.x: Well, I've been playing Sylvia instruments actually since 1927. Clarinet. Matter of fact, Howard sold me the first one. You remember? I bought the metal, the silver clarinet. Sure. Then I didn't care for it and I switched over to the wooden. Okay.
And, Scott, I know you have a lot of things to do.
That's all right. And, uh, I'll tell you what you can mention. The movies are not out yet. We scored two movies and the music is great on both of them. One is called Bridie of the Grand Canyon.
